items.source: Uses of LambdaSafe.Callback in org.springframework.boot.util
Represents a single callback that can be invoked in a lambda safe way.
items.translation: 代表一个可以以 Lambda 安全方式调用的单个回调。

items.source:
Start a call to a single callback instance, dealing with common generic type
concerns and exceptions.
items.translation: 向单个回调实例发起调用，处理通用的类型问题和异常。
